embedded_files.probe.py:
import sys,io,json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools')
from wallcrack import compile_c,extract,md
from elftools.elf.elffile import ELFFile
P=Path('build/modelanim2-cpp1012');N='_ZN10ModelAnim213Func_020162C4Eji5Fix12IiEt'
base=Path('src/'+N+'.c').read_text(); obj,err=compile_c(base); assert obj,err
P.joinpath('baseline.o').write_bytes(obj); target,rel=extract(obj,N); P.joinpath('baseline.asm').write_text('\n'.join('%03x %s %s'%(i.address,i.mnemonic,i.op_str) for i in md.disasm(target,0)))
rows=[]
for f in sorted(P.glob('*.cpp')):
 obj,err=compile_c(f.read_text(),True)
 if obj is None:rows.append(dict(name=f.stem,error=err));continue
 f.with_suffix('.o').write_bytes(obj);code,rel=extract(obj,N)
 if code is None:rows.append(dict(name=f.stem,error='missing symbol'));continue
 f.with_suffix('.asm').write_text('\n'.join('%03x %s %s'%(i.address,i.mnemonic,i.op_str) for i in md.disasm(code,0)))
 elf=ELFFile(io.BytesIO(obj));syms=elf.get_section_by_name('.symtab'); reloc=[]
 for sec in elf.iter_sections():
  if sec.header['sh_type'] in ('SHT_REL','SHT_RELA'):
   for r in sec.iter_relocations():reloc.append(dict(offset=r['r_offset'],type=r['r_info_type'],symbol=syms.get_symbol(r['r_info_sym']).name))
 rows.append(dict(name=f.stem,size=len(code),aligned_word_diffs_excluding_relocations=[o for o in range(0,min(len(code),len(target)),4) if o not in rel and code[o:o+4]!=target[o:o+4]],relocations=reloc))
P.joinpath('probe-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2));print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
